reviewMethod: Visual inspection of actual full-resolution final and conditioning images on 15 October. Qualitative research review, not a calibrated fit score.

different-garment.verdict: working controlled prototype with text/detail limitations
observations: Brown jersey color, contrast shoulder panels, V collar, large 95 and red sleeve motif transfer visibly. Both sleeves and hem are coherent with no large beige-shirt fragments.
Small chest lettering is distorted and the red motif is repeated on the other sleeve. Garment proportions and digit scale differ from the reference.
Face, hair, exposed arms, hands, trousers, shoes and background appear preserved.

shirt-category.verdict: working controlled prototype with print limitations
observations: Black shirt has a plausible neckline, both sleeves and hem. The uploaded oval graphic and major text are recognizable, with no obvious beige-shirt remnants.
Fine graphic/text details are distorted and the garment appears narrower than the flat-lay product. Physical fit is not validated.
Face, hair, arms, hands, trousers, shoes and background appear preserved.
